segments.text: Look at the label on your shirt, your phone, or your shoes.
segments.englishExplanation: An instruction to check where your everyday belongings were manufactured.
segments.turkishExplanation: Gömleğinizdeki, telefonunuzdaki veya ayakkabınızdaki etikete bakın.

segments.text: They were probably made far away.
segments.englishExplanation: A statement that these products were likely manufactured in a distant location.

segments.text: But when did the world become so connected?
segments.englishExplanation: A question introducing the historical origin of global interconnectedness.
segments.turkishExplanation: Peki dünya ne zaman bu kadar bağlantılı hale geldi?

segments.text: The modern age of globalization started with the industrial revolution at the end of the
segments.englishExplanation: Linking the origins of modern globalization to the industrial revolution.
segments.turkishExplanation: Küreselleşmenin modern çağı, 18. yüzyılın sonundaki sanayi devrimiyle başladı,

segments.text: 18th century, and new machines were able to produce cheaper goods.
segments.englishExplanation: Explaining how new machinery lowered the cost of manufactured items.
segments.turkishExplanation: ve yeni makineler daha ucuz mallar üretebildi.

segments.text: Factories could make in one day what workers had made in a month.
segments.englishExplanation: Comparing the rapid output of factories to traditional manual labor.
segments.turkishExplanation: Fabrikalar, işçilerin bir ayda yaptığını bir günde yapabiliyordu.

segments.text: Ships and trains carried these goods across oceans and borders.
segments.englishExplanation: Describing the transportation networks that moved products internationally.
segments.turkishExplanation: Gemiler ve trenler bu malları okyanusların ve sınırların ötesine taşıdı.

segments.text: Soon, a cup of tea in London depended on farms on the other side of the world.
segments.englishExplanation: Giving a practical example of how routine daily life became reliant on foreign supply chains.
segments.turkishExplanation: Çok geçmeden, Londra'daki bir fincan çay dünyanın öbür ucundaki çiftliklere bağımlı hale geldi.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: To rely on someone or something in order to exist, happen, or function properly.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir şeye veya birine bağımlı olmak, bir şeyin başka bir şeye bağlı olması anlamına gelir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: Our outdoor party will depend on the weather tomorrow.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Açık hava partimiz yarınki havaya bağlı olacak.

quiz.question: The modern age of globalization ______ with the industrial revolution at the end of the 18th century, and new machines ______ cheaper goods.

options.text: has started / are able to produce
